x: There are 17 SDGs, with 169 targets, to be met by 2030. The other options are those other numbers.
t: Discriminate 17 goals from 169 targets.

x: Option C is incorrect: the framework is titled 'Transforming our World: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development', not 2035. It was proposed at Rio+20 (2012).
t: Recall the 2030 Agenda title.

x: No Poverty is Goal 1, Clean Water and Sanitation Goal 6, Climate Action Goal 13, and Partnerships Goal 17. The answer is a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii.
t: Recall the SDG numbers.

x: Both are true: NITI Aayog oversees the SDGs in India, and the framework is called 'Transforming our World: the 2030 Agenda'.
t: Recall who tracks the SDGs in India.

x: SDG 2 is Zero Hunger, SDG 3 Good Health, SDG 4 Quality Education, and SDG 5 Gender Equality. The answer is a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the SDG numbers.

x: All four are correct: SDG 7 is clean energy, 8 decent work and growth, 9 industry and infrastructure, and 10 reduced inequalities.
t: Recall the SDG numbers.

x: SDG 11 is sustainable cities, 12 responsible consumption, 14 life below water, and 15 life on land. The answer is a-iii, b-ii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Remember: water (14) comes before land (15).

x: Both are true: SDG 15 is Life on Land, and SDG 16 is Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions.
t: Recall the SDG numbers.

x: Oilzapper, a mix of bacteria, cleans up oil spills and oily sludge. A microbial fuel cell treats wastewater, and EPR is a producer duty.
t: Match each method to its use.

x: Option B is incorrect: mercury comes under the Minamata Convention. Rotterdam deals with prior informed consent for hazardous chemicals and pesticides.
t: Match each treaty to its subject.

x: Both are true, and R restates A: the Kigali Amendment is about phasing down HFCs. R explains A.
t: Recognise when R restates A.

x: Biodiversity comes under the CBD, biosafety under Cartagena, access and benefit sharing under Nagoya, and plant genetic resources under ITPGRFA. The answer is a-iii, b-ii, c-i, d-iv.
t: Match each subject to its treaty.

x: The order is the Stockholm Declaration (1972), Our Common Future (1987), the Rio Declaration (1992) and the Johannesburg Declaration (2002). The answer is B, D, C, A.
t: Arrange the declarations in time order.

x: I, II and IV are correct: Agenda 21 is the action plan, the Forest Principles cover forests, and the Millennium Declaration set up the MDGs. III is false because 'The Future We Want' came out of Rio+20 in 2012.
t: Match each document to its year.

x: Bioremediation cleans toxic pollutants and oil spills, engineered microbes target specific pollutants, UV kills microbes in water, and pyrolysis turns waste into energy. The answer is a-iv, b-ii, c-i, d-iii.
t: Match each method to its use.

x: Plasma gasification turns waste into energy, bio-asphalt replaces petroleum asphalt, hydrogen gives clean energy and transport, and biofuels replace fossil fuels. The answer is a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i.
t: Match each method to its use.

x: Both are true: a green muffler (a tree belt) reduces noise and some air pollution, and Euro/BS norms control vehicle emissions. They are separate measures, so R does not explain A.
t: Ask whether two separate measures explain each other.

x: Renewable energy tackles fossil-fuel pollution by replacing coal and oil. The other options deal with waste or water.
t: Match each method to its use.

x: All four pairs are correct: landfill for disposal, incineration for burning, vermicomposting with worms, and bioremediation with microbes.
t: Check each pair.

x: Heritage comes under the World Heritage Convention, the climate framework is the UNFCCC, GHG commitments are Kyoto, and the 1.5°C goal is Paris. The answer is a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i.
t: Match each subject to its treaty.

x: Ozone comes under the Vienna Convention, phasing out ODS under the Montreal Protocol, hazardous waste under Basel, and the human environment under the Stockholm Declaration. The answer is a-iv, b-iii, c-i, d-ii.
t: Discriminate Vienna (framework) from Montreal (phase-out).

x: All three are correct: the Stockholm Declaration came from the first major UN environment conference, on the human environment, and 'Our Common Future' is the Brundtland Report.
t: Recall the Stockholm and Brundtland documents.

x: Our Common Future set out sustainable development, the Rio Declaration its principles, Agenda 21 was adopted in 1992, and the Forest Principles cover forest management. The answer is a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Match each document to its theme.

x: Both are true: the Johannesburg Declaration came from the 2002 World Summit on Sustainable Development and focused on putting commitments into practice.
t: Recall the Johannesburg summit.

x: All three are correct: the Millennium Declaration came in 2000, and the 2030 Agenda, with its 17 SDGs, was adopted in 2015.
t: Arrange the development agendas in time order.
